description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) for interacting with an LLM via a proxy server, including model selection, conversational management, and command handling. It uses the 'click' library for command parsing and 'rich' for UI display.

classes.name: ChatClient
classes.description: Client class to handle chat completion streaming requests to the proxy server

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _get_available_models(ctx: click.Context)
methods.description: Fetches list of available models from the proxy server, returns a list of models or empty list on error

methods.name: Optional[str] _select_model(console: Console, available_models: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Presents an interactive prompt to select a model from available models or enter a name directly

methods.name: chat( ctx: click.Context, model: Optional[str], temperature: float, max_tokens: Optional[int] = None, system: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Main CLI command for starting an interactive chat session with optional model, temperature, max tokens, and system message

methods.name: _show_help(console: Console)
methods.description: Displays help information for chat commands

methods.name: _save_conversation(console: Console, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], command: str)
methods.description: Saves current conversation messages to a JSON file

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _load_conversation(console: Console, command: str, system: Optional[str])
methods.description: Loads conversation messages from a JSON file

methods.name: tuple[bool,List[Dict[str,Any]],Optional[str]] _handle_special_commands( console: Console, user_input: str, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], system: Optional[str], ctx: click.Context )
methods.description: Handles special commands like /quit, /help, /history, /save, /load, /model and updates state accordingly

methods.name: Optional[str] _stream_response(console: Console, client: ChatClient, model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], temperature: float, max_tokens: Optional[int])
methods.description: Streams a response from the chat client and returns the complete assistant reply

ctags.name: _handle_special_commands
ctags.signature: ( console: Console, user_input: str, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], system: Optional[str], ctx: click.Context )

ctags.name: _load_conversation
ctags.pattern: /^def _load_conversation(console: Console, command: str, system: Optional[str]) -> List[Dict[str, /

ctags.name: _save_conversation
ctags.pattern: /^def _save_conversation(console: Console, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], command: str):$/
ctags.signature: (console: Console, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], command: str)

ctags.name: _stream_response
ctags.pattern: /^def _stream_response(console: Console, client: ChatClient, model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, /
ctags.signature: (console: Console, client: ChatClient, model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], temperature: float, max_tokens: Optional[int])

ctags.name: chat
ctags.signature: ( ctx: click.Context, model: Optional[str], temperature: float, max_tokens: Optional[int] = None, system: Optional[str] = None, )
